args.subject: Re: Design Tokens & Framework Inquiry - CarePortal Project
args.body:
Hi David,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the design tokens and framework used for the telehealth project I mentioned.

Due to strict NDA obligations with HorizonHealth Technologies, I'm unable to share specific design system details, component specifications, or framework configurations from their CarePortal project. This is a contractual requirement that applies to all projects under Strict Confidential agreements.

What I can tell you is that the project followed industry-standard accessibility guidelines and component architecture principles that are publicly available in our portfolio case studies (where permitted by client agreement).

I hope this helps clarify the situation. Please let me know if you have any other questions about the Nova Mobile project or upcoming sprint work.

Best regards,
Elena
